changelog.title: Now works in the browser too

sections.title: What's new
items: No app changes — the web playground can now connect Gmail: the wizard walks you through a Google "Web application" client instead of the desktop one.
If you use Snug on both surfaces, each keeps its own Google client registration; one sign-in is active per copy of the app.

sections.title: What's new
items: No app changes — taking this update seeds the app's wiki and build prompt into copies installed before doc seeding existed.

sections.title: What's new
items: See who is really filling your inbox — and who you never answer.
Mass cleanup you preview and approve once; nothing is deleted without you.
Desktop only at this release: Gmail was reached through Google’s desktop app sign-in (the web lane arrived in v3).
